title: Zesty Crispy German Cabbage Wrap
description: These zesty, crispy cabbage wraps combine sautéed vegetables with a kombu-infused glaze, delivering a flavorful, dairy-free bite. Perfect for a quick lunch or snack, they bring a German twist to your table.
instructions: Trim stems from the cabbage leaves and wash them thoroughly.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add diced onion, mushrooms, bell pepper, and garlic; sauté until softened.
Stir in kombu cold extract and cook for an additional minute to meld flavors.
Season the vegetable mixture with salt, pepper, nutritional yeast, and lemon juice, then stir well.
Place a spoonful of the sautéed mixture onto each cabbage leaf, fold the sides over, and roll tightly.
Arrange the wraps seam-side down in the skillet and cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, until the leaves are crisp and golden, about 5 minutes per side.
Plate the wraps and serve immediately, optionally garnishing with extra lemon wedges or fresh herbs.
Enjoy the zesty, crispy German cabbage wraps as a quick lunch or crowd-pleasing snack.
